questions.q: The price of an item is reduced by 20%. As a result, customers can get 2 kg more of it for ₹360. Find the original price (in ₹) per kg of the item.
questions.s:
Given:

The price of an item is reduced by 20%. As a result, customers can get 2 kg more of it for ₹360

Calculation:

20% = 1/5

Let the actual price be 5x

So, after reduction it will be 4x

According to the question,

(360/4x) - (360/5x) = 2

⇒ (90/x) - (72/x) = 2

⇒ [(90 - 72)/x] = 2

⇒ 18 = 2x

⇒ x = 9

So, actual price = 5 × 9 = 45

∴ The original price (in ₹) per kg of the item is 45.

questions.q: There are 10 stations on a railways line. What is the number of different journey tickets that are required for railway authorities?
questions.s:
Given:

Number of stations on railway line = 10

Calculations:

So the number of different journey tickets between two stations from given 10 stations from one side = 10C2 =  (10×9)/2

Similarly, number of different journey tickets from other side = 45 

Total number of tickets to be generated by authorities = 45 + 45 = 90

Shortcut Trick

Number of different journey tickets = 10P2 = 10 × 9 = 90

Note: we have taken 10P2 instead of 10C2 because ticket for station A to B is considered as different from the ticket for station B to A

questions.q: A college hostel mess has provisions for 25 days for 350 boys. At the end of 10 days, when some boys were shifted to another hostel, it was found that now the provisions will last for 21 more days. How may boys were shifted to another hostel?
questions.s:
Given:

A college hostel mess has provisions for 25 days for 350 boys.

At the end of 10 days, when some boys were shifted to another hostel, it was found that now the provisions will last for 21 more days.

Concept used:

Available provisions = Number of days × Number of boys

Calculation:

Available provisions = 25 × 350 = 8750 units

After 10 days the remaining provision = 8750 - 10 × 350

⇒ 5250 units

Let N number of boys shifted to another hostel.

According to the question,

(350 - N) × 21 = 5250

⇒ 350 - N = 5250/21

⇒ 350 - N = 250

⇒ N = 350 - 250

⇒ N = 100

∴ 100 boys were shifted to another hostel.

questions.q: A retailer marks an air conditioner 80% above its cost price. He offers a first discount of 25% on the marked price. During a festive offer, an additional discount of 10% is applied on the already discounted price. If the final selling price is ₹15,552, what is the approximate cost price of the air conditioner?"
questions.s:
Given:

Marked price = 80% above Cost Price

First discount = 25%

Second discount = 10%

Final Selling Price = ₹15,552

Formula used:

MP = CP × 180 / 100

Successive discount factor = (1 − 25/100) × (1 − 10/100)

Calculations:

⇒ Let Cost Price = x

⇒ MP = 1.8x

⇒ After 25% discount ⇒ 1.8x × 75 / 100

⇒ After 10% discount ⇒ 1.8x × 75 / 100 × 90 / 100

⇒ SP = 1.8x × 0.75 × 0.9

⇒ SP = 1.8x × 0.675

⇒ SP = 1.215x

⇒ 1.215x = 15,552

⇒ x = 15,552 / 1.215

⇒ x = 12,800

∴ The approximate cost price of the air conditioner is ₹12,800.

In a family of eight members, K has two daughters A and B.

D and E are the sons of M.

The daughter of J is the child of A. M is the father-in-law of J.

Neither the sons of K are married nor O is married.

Therefore, O will be the daughter of A.

So, O is the niece of E.

questions_hin.q_hi: The price of an item is reduced by 20%. As a result, customers can get 2 kg more of it for ₹360. Find the original price (in ₹) per kg of the item.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

The price of an item is reduced by 20%. As a result, customers can get 2 kg more of it for ₹360

Calculation:

20% = 1/5

Let the actual price be 5x

So, after reduction it will be 4x

According to the question,

(360/4x) - (360/5x) = 2

⇒ (90/x) - (72/x) = 2

⇒ [(90 - 72)/x] = 2

⇒ 18 = 2x

⇒ x = 9

So, actual price = 5 × 9 = 45

∴ The original price (in ₹) per kg of the item is 45.

It effectively serves as a crucial direct geographical link exactly connecting the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of Pakistan seamlessly with the remote Paktika and Ghazni provinces of neighboring Afghanistan. / रणनीतिक रूप से महत्वपूर्ण और ऐतिहासिक रूप से गहरा गोमल दर्रा एक अत्यधिक महत्वपूर्ण प्राचीन पहाड़ी दर्रा है जो सीधे बीहड़ हिंदू कुश पर्वतमाला में गहराई से स्थित है। यह पाकिस्तान के खैबर पख्तूनख्वा प्रांत को पड़ोसी अफगानिस्तान के दूरस्थ पक्तिका और गजनी प्रांतों के साथ निर्बाध रूप से जोड़ने वाले एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रत्यक्ष भौगोलिक लिंक के रूप में प्रभावी रूप से कार्य करता है।

questions_hin.q_hi:
प्रश्न: एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में 'apple' शब्द के लिए क्या कूट (code) है?
कथन:
I. 'eat fresh apple' को 'ti mi pa' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है।
II. 'fresh red apple' को 'pa mi re' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है।
o_hi: अकेले कथन I में डेटा पर्याप्त है
अकेले कथन II में डेटा पर्याप्त है
दोनों कथन एक साथ आवश्यक हैं
दोनों कथन एक साथ पर्याप्त नहीं हैं
questions_hin.s_hi:
I और II से, सामान्य शब्द 'fresh' और 'apple' हैं। सामान्य कोड 'mi' और 'pa' हैं।
हम यह निर्धारित नहीं कर सकते कि 'apple' का सटीक कोड 'mi' है या 'pa'। इसलिए, दोनों कथनों का उपयोग करने के बाद भी डेटा पर्याप्त नहीं है।

questions_hin.q_hi:
Amit said to Krish, "That person who is giving speech is the son of the only daughter of your sibling's mother." How the person who is giving speech is related to Krish? [Consider Krish as a female]

अमित ने क्रिश से कहा कि, "वह व्यक्ति जो भाषण दे रहा है वह तुम्हारे सहोदर की माता की इकलौती पुत्री का पुत्र है।" भाषण देने वाला व्यक्ति क्रिश से किस प्रकार संबंधित है? [क्रिश को महिला मानें]
questions_hin.s_hi:
It is given that, Amit said to Krish, "That person who is giving speech is the son of the only daughter of your sibling's mother."

Given that Krish is a female.

So her sibling's mother's only daughter is Krish.

So, the person is the son of Krish.

questions_hin.q_hi: A machine takes 10 h to cut 240 tools. How many tools will it cut in 25 h?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

A machine takes 10 h to cut 240 tools.

Calculation:

In 10 h the machine can cut 240 tools

So, in 1 h the machine can cut 24 tools

Now in 25 h the machine will cut 24 × 25

⇒ 600

∴ The required answer is 600.

It serves the absolutely critical, unparalleled geostrategic function of directly and seamlessly connecting the busy Mediterranean Sea (in the distant north) exclusively to the crucial 'Red Sea' (in the deep south). / विश्व स्तर पर विशाल स्वेज नहर के रूप में जाना जाने वाला शानदार और गहरे ऐतिहासिक इंजीनियरिंग चमत्कार मिस्र में पूरी तरह से स्थित एक अत्यधिक रणनीतिक कृत्रिम समुद्री स्तर का जलमार्ग है। यह व्यस्त भूमध्य सागर (दूर उत्तर में) को विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण 'लाल सागर' (गहरे दक्षिण में) से सीधे और निर्बाध रूप से जोड़ने के बिल्कुल महत्वपूर्ण, अद्वितीय भू-रणनीतिक कार्य को पूरा करता है।

questions_hin.q_hi: A college hostel mess has provisions for 25 days for 350 boys. At the end of 10 days, when some boys were shifted to another hostel, it was found that now the provisions will last for 21 more days. How may boys were shifted to another hostel?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

A college hostel mess has provisions for 25 days for 350 boys.

At the end of 10 days, when some boys were shifted to another hostel, it was found that now the provisions will last for 21 more days.

Concept used:

Available provisions = Number of days × Number of boys

Calculation:

Available provisions = 25 × 350 = 8750 units

After 10 days the remaining provision = 8750 - 10 × 350

⇒ 5250 units

Let N number of boys shifted to another hostel.

According to the question,

(350 - N) × 21 = 5250

⇒ 350 - N = 5250/21

⇒ 350 - N = 250

⇒ N = 350 - 250

⇒ N = 100

∴ 100 boys were shifted to another hostel.

questions_hin.q_hi: A retailer marks an air conditioner 80% above its cost price. He offers a first discount of 25% on the marked price. During a festive offer, an additional discount of 10% is applied on the already discounted price. If the final selling price is ₹15,552, what is the approximate cost price of the air conditioner?"
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

Marked price = 80% above Cost Price

First discount = 25%

Second discount = 10%

Final Selling Price = ₹15,552

Formula used:

MP = CP × 180 / 100

Successive discount factor = (1 − 25/100) × (1 − 10/100)

Calculations:

⇒ Let Cost Price = x

⇒ MP = 1.8x

⇒ After 25% discount ⇒ 1.8x × 75 / 100

⇒ After 10% discount ⇒ 1.8x × 75 / 100 × 90 / 100

⇒ SP = 1.8x × 0.75 × 0.9

⇒ SP = 1.8x × 0.675

⇒ SP = 1.215x

⇒ 1.215x = 15,552

⇒ x = 15,552 / 1.215

⇒ x = 12,800

∴ The approximate cost price of the air conditioner is ₹12,800.

In a family of eight members, K has two daughters A and B. D and E are the sons of M. The daughter of J is the child of A. M is the father-in-law of J. Neither the sons of K are married nor O is married. How is O related to E?

आठ सदस्यों वाले एक परिवार में, K की दो पुत्रियाँ A और B हैं। D और E, M के पुत्र हैं। J की पुत्री, A की संतान है। M, J का ससुर है। न तो K का पुत्र विवाहित है और न ही O विवाहित है। O, E से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
In a family of eight members, K has two daughters A and B.

D and E are the sons of M.

The daughter of J is the child of A. M is the father-in-law of J.

Neither the sons of K are married nor O is married.

Therefore, O will be the daughter of A.

So, O is the niece of E.

questions_hin.q_hi: Q34. Which volcano is a classic example of a shield volcano, lava flows spreading over wide areas? / कौन सा ज्वालामुखी एक ढाल ज्वालामुखी (shield volcano) का एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है, जिसका लावा प्रवाह विस्तृत क्षेत्रों में फैलता है? [Delhi Police Constable, 04 Jan 2026, Shift-2]
o_hi: Mount St. Helens / माउंट सेंट हेलेंस
questions_hin.s_hi: The colossal 'Mauna Loa', located aggressively on the massive Big Island of Hawaii, is the absolute largest and most quintessential textbook example of a perfect 'Shield Volcano' anywhere on Earth. It is meticulously built almost entirely of highly fluid, fast-moving (low-viscosity) basaltic lava flows that travel immense, staggering distances before finally cooling. / विशाल बिग आइलैंड ऑफ हवाई पर आक्रामक रूप से स्थित विशाल 'मौना लोआ', पृथ्वी पर कहीं भी एक आदर्श 'शील्ड ज्वालामुखी' (Shield Volcano) का पूर्ण सबसे बड़ा और सबसे सर्वोत्कृष्ट पाठ्यपुस्तक उदाहरण है। यह लगभग पूरी तरह से अत्यधिक तरल, तेजी से बहने वाले (कम चिपचिपाहट वाले) बेसाल्टिक लावा प्रवाह से सावधानीपूर्वक बनाया गया है जो अंततः ठंडा होने से पहले विशाल, चौंका देने वाली दूरी तय करता है।
